chosen_titles.rationale: Title 41 (State Government) houses A.R.S. Ch. 7, Art. 8.1 (Lobbyists, §§41-1231 through 41-1239) — the state's single lobbying-disclosure regime administered by the Secretary of State.

notes: AZ 2025 hosted on Justia. Single-body lobbying regime in Title 41. Title 16 (Elections and Electors) excluded — campaign finance, out of scope. Title 38 (Public Officers and Employees) excluded — general ethics rules, lobbying disclosure proper lives in Title 41.
